text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council amended the Public Appointments process to authorize the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Sona Dhawan to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on March 12, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.
